correctionUnauthorized: Transcript correction is no longer authorized.
title: Transcript
description: Timeline text is derived from corrected ASR output. Human edits are versioned.
processFirst: Process a recording to generate a transcript.
coverageWarning: Unresolved or suspicious speech coverage exists. Review the source audio before relying on this transcript.
reviewGate_description: Meeting Intelligence can be admitted only from this finalized, source-bound transcript revision.
reviewGate_computingDigest: Computing the canonical transcript evidence digest…
reviewGate_digestUnverified: Transcript evidence could not be verified.
reviewGate_unauthorized: The current meeting authorization does not permit review acknowledgement or Meeting Intelligence admission.
reviewGate_mutationBlocked: Finish or discard the active transcript correction or speaker mapping before changing the review gate.
reviewGate_uncertain: A prior request has an uncertain outcome. Recover the original intent before starting another operation, even if the evidence changed.
reviewGate_previousAdmission: A previous Meeting Intelligence admission was confirmed by Core.
reviewGate_acknowledgementStatement: I reviewed the complete transcript and its source coverage. I understand this acknowledgement is for the exact revision shown above.
reviewGate_receiptCurrent: The review receipt is current. Admission is a separate, idempotent Core operation.
reviewGate_admissionConfirmed: Meeting Intelligence admission confirmed by Core.
reviewGate_requestUnresolved: A transcript review request is unresolved. Job progression alone does not confirm that request.
reviewGate_receiptRevision: Core confirmed an acknowledgement for revision {{revision}}. Verify the evidence against the current revision before using this receipt.
reviewGate_committedBeforeAuth: The request may have committed before authorization changed.
reviewGate_authBeforeSend: Authorization changed before the request was sent.
reviewGate_changedEvidence: The transcript evidence changed. A fresh acknowledgement is required.
reviewGate_evidenceUnavailable: The canonical transcript evidence is no longer available. Review must be re-established.
reviewGate_historicalReceipt: This acknowledgement belongs to a historical transcript revision.
reviewGate_actorUnauthorized: The current actor cannot manage transcript review.
reviewGate_resolveReview: Finish or discard unresolved transcript review work.
reviewGate_evidenceUnverified: Current transcript evidence is not verified.
reviewGate_resolveProcessing: Resolve the outstanding processing operation first.
reviewGate_wrongMeeting: The transcript belongs to another meeting.
reviewGate_jobSourceUnverified: Current job and source evidence are not verified.
reviewGate_notWaiting: The exact processing job is not waiting for transcript review.
reviewGate_sourceUnavailable: The reviewed source media is not available.
reviewGate_verifyCurrent: The current transcript must be verified again.
reviewGate_verifyCoverage: Coverage and speaker evidence must finish verification.
